title: Update Frolik
subtitle: Frolik has changed in a way your installed app can't pick up by itself. Reinstall it to get the new version — it only takes a minute.

ios.step1: Press and hold the Frolik icon on your Home Screen
ios.step2: Tap Remove App, then Delete from Home Screen

android.step1: Press and hold the Frolik icon, then tap Uninstall

note: Your account, Outings and photos are safe. Just log in again after reinstalling.
